children: Ecuador's state-run oil company Petroecuador on Saturday declared force majeure at a pumping station on its SOTE pipeline following a fire earlier this week, and said it expects to restore operations within six days.
The October 1 blaze occurred at Pumping Station 4 in Baeza. Petroecuador said it has deployed technical teams to work around the clock to repair infrastructure and resume pumping.

The company requested an investigation by specialized police units, including the National Unit for the Investigation of Hydrocarbon Crimes and the Special Intervention Group (GIR), to determine the cause of the fire and identify those responsible.

Petroecuador added that it implemented an operational plan to minimize the impact on the country's oil supply chain while repairs are underway. The SOTE pipeline has a capacity of 360,000 barrels per day.
